# ZoneWise.AI — Agentic AI Ecosystem for Florida Real Estate Intelligence

> ZoneWise.AI, powered by BidDeed.AI and Everest Capital USA, is an agentic AI ecosystem for zoning compliance, foreclosure auction intelligence, and parcel analysis across all 67 Florida counties.

## What ZoneWise.AI Does

ZoneWise.AI provides AI-powered intelligence for real estate investors, developers, and professionals operating in Florida:

- **Zoning Intelligence:** Instant zoning lookups across 369 jurisdictions and 5,950 zoning districts covering 10.8 million parcels statewide.
- **Foreclosure Auction Data:** Live foreclosure auction tracking powered by BidDeed.AI, with deal scoring, judgment analysis, and automated bid calculations.
- **Parcel Analysis:** Detailed parcel reports including zoning classification, permitted uses, setbacks, and development feasibility.
- **Choropleth Maps:** Free interactive zoning maps for every Florida county — color-coded by district, filterable by use type.
- **AI Chat Assistant:** Conversational interface for zoning questions, auction research, and property due diligence.

## Coverage

- **Counties:** All 67 Florida counties
- **Jurisdictions:** 369 municipal and unincorporated jurisdictions
- **Zoning Districts:** 5,950 unique zoning classifications
- **Parcels:** 10.8 million parcels statewide
- **Auction Data:** Daily foreclosure auction updates via BidDeed.AI pipeline

## Products

- **Free Tier:** Choropleth zoning maps, basic parcel lookups, county-level auction summaries.
- **Pro Tier ($99/mo):** AI chat assistant, detailed zoning reports, auction deal scoring, feasibility analysis, property envelope calculations.

## About

ZoneWise.AI is built by Everest Capital USA, a Florida-based real estate investment firm founded by Ariel Shapira. With 10+ years of foreclosure investing experience in Brevard County, FL, Everest Capital developed ZoneWise.AI and BidDeed.AI to bring institutional-grade intelligence to individual investors.

- **Website:** https://zonewise.ai
- **Auction Intelligence:** https://biddeed.ai
- **Parent Company:** Everest Capital USA, Satellite Beach, FL
- **Contact:** ariel@everestcapitalusa.com

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js, deployed on Vercel
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Maps: Mapbox GL JS
- AI: Multi-model architecture (Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude)

## Structured Data Available

- Organization schema (Everest Capital USA)
- SoftwareApplication schema (ZoneWise.AI)
- LocalBusiness schema (Florida service area)
- FAQPage schema (foreclosure and zoning Q&A)

## Related Projects

- **BidDeed.AI** — Foreclosure auction intelligence platform (https://biddeed.ai)
- **ZoneWise Scraper** — Open data pipeline for Florida zoning districts
- **Tax Insurance Optimizer** — Property tax and insurance analysis tools
